method: One cold job plus five warm jobs per process, serial randomized configuration/dataset groups. Compression/recovery include file I/O, checksums and output sync. Cold includes session/pool initialization; all exclude executable startup. Codec time includes numeric selection, transfers, synchronization and framing; verification and reference recompression are outside timers. Recovery uses the original CPU decoder. OS/driver caches are uncontrolled. Original versus converted real samples are separate datasets.
resume_note: Resumed verified completed groups after a checkpoint-write failure. Only persistence/resume logic changed; codec binary, corpus, configurations and timing boundaries are unchanged.
